item.title: [ZEPPELIN-76] Hide large IntegrationTests with Selenium for ZeppelinServer under a profile
item.description:
Right now on every mvn package large Selenium based tests in Scala are run (and fail on most local machines, but pass on CI).

It is good that we have them but there should be explicit way to run them when needed and skip those in favor of development productivity

I.e they can be hidden under mvn verify instead, so users become less in a habit of just adding -DskipTests all the time and CI who is doing mvn verify will still run them.
item.summary: Hide large IntegrationTests with Selenium for ZeppelinServer under a profile

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

GitHub user bzz opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/incubator-zeppelin/pull/280

ZEPPELIN-76 skip Selenium tests on package

Selenium-based tests are now triggerd by scalatest, instead of maven-failsafe-plugin, that is why they were triggered on `mvn package`.

This PR moves scalatest invocation further down the chain, i.e now only `mvn verify` or `mvn install` will trigger them.

No more `-DskipTests` by default!
